title: Vector quant anchor and periodic cosine-audit for INT8/FP16 embedding profiles
creator: Priya Malhotra
description: Problem: We are introducing an INT8 serving profile for a high-use embeddings model with FP16 as the reference baseline. Early calibration runs show small but persistent cosine-similarity shifts for certain corpora. This ticket implements an anchored quantization verification + periodic cosine-audit that: (1) defines anchor vectors and acceptance thresholds per corpus, (2) adds an automated nightly calibration job that rechecks drift and triggers recalibration or rollback, and (3) wires alerts and dashboards in Console for triage. Scope excludes retraining or model architecture changes; focuses on calibration params, sampling strategy, and ops playbook.
acceptance_criteria: A stable anchor set (per-corpus) is defined and stored in ops datastore
Nightly audit job computes cosine distributions for INT8 vs FP16 and emits metrics to Console
Thresholds (mean and tail percentiles) established with documented remediation actions
Automatic rollback or canary mitigation flow is implemented for >X% corpus regressions
Runbook and alerting for on-call with remediation checklist are published in Confluence
End-to-end test that simulates a 2% cosine drop and verifies alert + rollback path
tasks: Design anchor selection algorithm and sampling parameters
Implement calibration harness that produces INT8 quant profiles and side-by-side FP16 embeddings
Build nightly audit job (k8s CronJob) to compute cosine similarity distributions and summary stats
Add metrics: mean cosine diff, 1st/5th/50th/95th percentiles, regression_count_by_corpus
Create Console dashboard for per-corpus drift visualization and alert rules
Implement automated mitigation: canary-swap or use FP16 fallback route
Write runbook with verification commands, rollback steps, and owner assignments
Create unit/integration tests for calibration pipeline and monitoring alerts
calibration_workflow: 1) Reservoir sampling of corpus-specific anchor candidates (N=10k per corpus)
2) Generate FP16 reference embeddings for anchor set with deterministic RNG seed
3) Run quantizer to create INT8 profile with current calibration parameters
4) Produce INT8 embeddings for anchor set and compute cosine similarity distribution vs FP16
5) Persist summary statistics and store raw anchor vectors for auditability
6) If metrics exceed thresholds, flag for manual calibration or auto-trigger recalibration sweep
monitoring_playbook: Alert severity mapping: warning = 0.5% anchors below threshold, critical = 2% anchors below threshold
On warning: run adhoc calibration-debug job and assign to embedding-stability oncall
On critical: trigger automated canary fallback to FP16 profile for affected corpora and page SRE
Triage steps: compare raw vectors, inspect per-layer histograms, replay calibration with alternate thresholds
If root cause is quant profile bug, open ENG bug linking PR and revert rollout
If cause is corpus shift, schedule a recalc and update anchor snapshots with versioned metadata
notes: We intentionally keep anchors immutable per-release to detect drift vs a fixed baseline; new release can refresh anchors after validation
Avoid sampling only high-frequency queries; include stratified buckets by query length and token types
Consider storing compressed anchor vectors (quantized with lossless index) to keep storage costs low
This work should interoperate with current emb-qprofile calibration harness (no invasive changes to runtime)
